synopsis: Chapter 11 identifies NI VeriStand with PXI and CompactRIO as commercial offerings for data replay and hardware-in-the-loop testing [f8363, f9224]. The listed capabilities include real-time testing, plant models, logging and hardware-in-the-loop I/O, with plant models and I/O also explicitly listed as interfaces [f8643, f9226]. The PXIe-8842 controller costs about USD 5,200; the glossary clarifies that this price covers only the controller, not a complete HIL bench, while a NI VeriStand/PXI/CompactRIO system requires a quote [f9227, f16035]. The evidence provided is general hardware-in-the-loop evidence, and no latest release was found, leaving the documented evidence scope and release currency limited [f9225, f9228].
